guard/31981.htm.text: Captain Vishotsky: If a village is peaceful, security must be tight, right? While we're on the subject, let me tell you that a neutral village like this one actually means more work for us guards. If we are vigilant, the inhabitants complain that we are being repressive. If we ease off, they compla…

links.text: Look at the list of Kamaloka.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-01..text: Captain Vishotsky: I heard tales of your recent activities. You have already acquired a reputation as an accomplished adventurer. Perhaps you have already heard about the Mutated Kaneus of Kamaloka . I have been asked to help investigate these strange creatures, but my duties unfortunately keep me …

links.text: "What kind of help do you need?"

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-00..text: Captain Vishotsky: Based on my observations, I don't think you are yet ready to handle the Kaneus here. (Only characters level 58 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-05..text: Captain Vishotsky: Ah! Are these the cellular tissues of Venomous Storace and Kel Bilette ? From their pristine appearance, I can tell you were very careful. I couldn't have done better myself. Well done! Now take these samples to Magister Atraxia at the Temple of Einhasad. He will be very pleased.…

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-04..text: Captain Vishotsky: The magisters become agitated if their research is delayed for any reason, so deliver the cellular tissue samples as quickly as possible. Those aren't people you want irritated with you, you know! Hurry to Kamaloka, and good hunting!

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-06..text: Captain Vishotsky: Ah, it's you! Magister Atraxia asked me to convey his gratitude to you. He said that the cellular tissues of the mutated Kaneus from the Kamaloka of Schuttgart that you delivered to the Sages of Magic were a great help. Well done!

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-02..text: Captain Vishotsky: The favor I ask is on behalf of Magister Atraxia of the Temple of Einhasad. The Sages of Magic, a group of magisters of which Magister Atraxia is a member, are researching the Kaneus: recently discovered monsters of Kamaloka. They know that Kamaloka exists between this world and …

Q10280_MutatedKaneusSchuttgart/31981-03..text: Captain Vishotsky: Excellent! Visit either of the 2 Kamalokas we can enter from Schuttgart, kill the Kaneus there and extract their cellular tissues.
